verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers' core product is an edge cloud platform (global network, KV, D1, R2) delivered as a managed SaaS; while the request-simulator (workerd) is open source, there is no evidence of a supported path to self-host the actual production platform, and community feedback explicitly cites KV/D1 lock-in as a barrier to running the same code outside Cloudflare's infrastructure (cloudflare-comm-10). missing for 10: any first-party self-hosting/on-prem deployment docs, evidence of running the full platform (storage, global network) outside Cloudflare's own infrastructure, and confirmation that lock-in concerns are unfounded.
